The '''2014–15 Eredivisie''' season was the 59th season of the [[Eredivisie]] since its establishment in 1955. On 18 April 2015, [[PSV Eindhoven|PSV]] were confirmed as champions of the season, thus ending the four-year reign of [[AFC Ajax|Ajax]].

== Teams ==
A total of 18 teams took part in the league: The best fifteen teams from the [[2013–14 Eredivisie|2013–14 season]], two promotion/relegation playoff winners and the [[2013–14 Eerste Divisie]] champions.

There are three teams that played in the 2013–14 Eerste Divisie that were promoted to the Eredivisie for the 2014–15 season. Willem II returned to the Eredivisie after just one season by winning its first Eerste Divisie title in 49 years. Meanwhile, FC Dordrecht and Excelsior navigated to the promotion/relegation playoffs to reach the Eredivisie, with both clubs having received byes after finishing second and third in the Eerste Divisie. FC Dordrecht swept both legs against VVV-Venlo 5–2 on aggregate in the second round before facing another Eerste Divisie club for a spot in the Eredivisie (after Sparta Rotterdam sent NEC Nijmegen into relegation). FC Dordrecht won 5–3 on aggregate to return to the Eredivisie for the first time in 19 years.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://int.soccerway.com/matches/2014/05/18/netherlands/nacompetitie/bvo-fc-dordrecht/sparta-rotterdam-bv/1681053/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140521205315/http://int.soccerway.com/matches/2014/05/18/netherlands/nacompetitie/bvo-fc-dordrecht/sparta-rotterdam-bv/1681053/|url-status=dead|archive-date=May 21, 2014|title=Dordrecht vs. Sparta Rotterdam - 18 May 2014 - Soccerway|website=Soccerway}}</ref>

Excelsior returned after two seasons in the Eerste Divisie by first overcoming FC Den Bosch 5–2 on aggregate before relegating RKC Waalwijk from the league by winning 4–2 on aggregate.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://int.soccerway.com/matches/2014/05/18/netherlands/nacompetitie/rkc-waalwijk/sbv-excelsior/1681057/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140522070311/http://int.soccerway.com/matches/2014/05/18/netherlands/nacompetitie/rkc-waalwijk/sbv-excelsior/1681057/|url-status=dead|archive-date=May 22, 2014|title=RKC Waalwijk vs. Excelsior - 18 May 2014 - Soccerway|website=Soccerway}}</ref>

=== Promotion/relegation play-offs ===
Ten teams, two from the Eredivisie and eight from the [[2014–15 Eerste Divisie|Eerste Divisie]], played for two spots in the [[2015–16 Eredivisie]], the remaining eight teams play in the [[2015–16 Eerste Divisie]].
